root_text:
-PRSE inhibited influenza A virus replication in human lung cells by over 80%.
The extract blocked the entry of RSV and HMPV into cells, preventing infection and replication.

nodes.text: These findings highlight the potential of polyphenol-rich sugarcane extract (PRSE) as a natural antiviral agent that could complement existing treatments and reduce dependence on synthetic antiviral drugs.
